name: freehub2copilot
description: The free-model-hub daemon's roster — free lane, Kilo, 13 account channels, your relays — directly in Copilot Chat as a BYOK provider. Zero configuration on the machine that runs the hub.

commands.title: Free Model Hub: Show Connection Status
Free Model Hub: Refresh Model Catalog

freehub.baseUrl.description: The hub's OpenAI-compatible base URL. The default serves the local daemon; change it only when the hub runs on another machine.

freehub.apiKey.description: The hub's server key. Leave empty to auto-read it from the local hub's data directory (~/.free-model-hub/hub/settings.json) — zero configuration on the machine that runs the hub.

freehub.refreshSeconds.description: How often the model catalog is re-read from the hub (channels logging in, relays added — all flow through).

freehub.debug.description: Verbose logging (Output: Free Model Hub for Copilot).
